2121611152899678320.en_summary: $CRWV buying opportunity for LT. It rents GPU compute by the hour to AI labs, with a backlog of $132.5B and a full-year guide that was just raised. The model is simple: buy capacity, lease it on multi-year contracts. The company says it turns profitable in 2028 — until then, the question is funding the buildout without drowning in interest costs.
2121611152899678320.zh_summary: $CRWV 長期買入機會。它按小時向AI實驗室出租GPU計算，積壓1325億美元，全年指引剛剛上調。模式簡單：購買容量，以多年合同租賃。公司稱2028年轉盈——在那之前，問題是融資建設而不被利息成本淹沒。

2121610960985072028.en_summary: $INTC The turnaround: a CPU franchise that still ships in volume, plus a foundry business being built to make chips for others. The long-term case is that the foundry becomes a second engine if the manufacturing execution holds. The honest caveat is that turnarounds are proven in years, not quarters.
2121610960985072028.zh_summary: $INTC 轉折：仍然大量出貨的CPU業務，加上正在建設的代工業務為他人製造芯片。長期理由是如果製造執行維持，代工成為第二引擎。誠實的警告是轉折在年份而非季度證明。

2121610854999236909.en_summary: $SNDK NAND flash for AI storage, where the data that trains models has to live. Demand is rising with AI infrastructure, and the company is splitting its stock 8-for-1 this week, which changes who can buy it, not what it is worth. The long-term case is storage demand tracking compute demand.
2121610854999236909.zh_summary: $SNDK AI存儲的NAND閃存，訓練模型的數據必須居住的地方。需求隨AI基礎設施上升，公司本週進行8比1股票拆分，這改變誰能買它，而非它的價值。長期理由是存儲需求跟隨計算需求。

2121610725260919044.en_summary: $MU Memory is the quiet bottleneck of AI: every accelerator needs high-bandwidth memory next to it, and supply is tight. $MU sells DRAM and NAND into that shortage, and the memory cycle is turning up after years of oversupply. The case is a multi-year memory upcycle; the risk is that memory has always been cyclical, and cycles turn.
2121610725260919044.zh_summary: $MU 記憶體是AI的安靜瓶頸：每個加速器都需要旁邊的高帶寬記憶體，供應緊張。$MU向該短缺銷售DRAM和NAND，記憶體週期在多年過剩後轉向。理由是多年記憶體上升週期；風險是記憶體一直是週期性的，週期會轉。
